sources.entry: WebPonize - WebPonize is a macOS App for converting PNG, JPEG, animated (or not) GIF images into WebP.

summary.one_liner: WebPonize is a macOS app for converting PNG, JPEG, and GIF images (including animated GIFs) into WebP format.
summary.what_it_does: The README was not available, so this summary relies on the repository metadata and the listing description. According to the listing, WebPonize converts PNG, JPEG, and animated or static GIF images into WebP. Beyond that conversion purpose, no further features, settings, or workflow details could be confirmed from the source material.
use_cases: optimize images for the web on macOS
notable: Native macOS app for WebP conversion
Handles animated GIFs as well as static images
caveats: README not available, so setup, build steps, and limitations could not be verified
